strings.feedback.password.load_failed: Could not load the saved password. Enter a replacement and save.

strings.db.tls.retry.body: Disable TLS and retry once? The connection will be unencrypted. This option is retained only after success.

strings.db.tls.retry.draft: Retry succeeded. TLS is disabled in this draft; complete the connection details and save.
strings.db.tls.retry.saved: Retry succeeded. The disabled TLS option has been saved.

strings.dbwork.copy.new_file: Choose a new absolute file path; existing files cannot be overwritten.
strings.dbwork.copy.confirm_data: Copy schema and data without overwriting an existing destination.
strings.dbwork.copy.done: Copied to {name} ({count} tables). Create a connection to open the destination.

strings.settings2.page_hint: Applies to newly opened tables. Use each table toolbar for individual page sizes.
strings.settings2.sql_pending: Notebook SQL execution is not available yet. Execution keys and destructive SQL confirmation retain safe defaults until it is connected.

strings.import.detect.password_hint: Password is used only for this detection and is not saved. Leave empty if none.

strings.import.detect.failed: Detection ended without a database list.
strings.transfer.unsupported: Full transfers currently support MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Other drivers are not connected yet.
strings.transfer.title: Database transfer
strings.transfer.file: File (.db for full SQLite backups; .sql for SQL content)
strings.transfer.scope: Preview: up to 5 rows / 16 columns. Unavailable object options depend on the driver. Selecting tables excludes independent views. Data import validates destination columns; SQLite uses DELETE instead of TRUNCATE and a single transaction. PostgreSQL currently supports append only.
strings.transfer.confirm_body: Execute this transfer? New databases and export files never overwrite existing destinations. SQL imports execute the entire file, which may affect other objects. Failure or cancellation can leave committed changes; no automatic retry occurs.
strings.transfer.cancelling: Cancelling; waiting for the operation to stop…
strings.transfer.new_required: Enter a new database name or choose a new file.
strings.transfer.confirm_export: Export the selected content to a new file without changing the source or overwriting an existing file?
strings.transfer.confirm_copy: Create a new destination database and copy the selected content without overwriting an existing database? Failure or cancellation may leave a partial new database.
strings.transfer.confirm_connection: Import the selected content? Schema import requires an empty destination. Confirm the write mode below. Failure or cancellation may leave committed changes.
strings.transfer.invalid_batch: Batch rows must be between 1 and 10000.
strings.transfer.mode.replace_warning: This clears all existing rows in the selected destination tables before inserting. MySQL TRUNCATE cannot be rolled back; cancellation may leave empty or partially filled tables.
strings.transfer.file_scope: SQL files execute unchanged. Table selection and write modes apply to connection imports only. Preview shows script lines, not executed data.
strings.transfer.connection_changed: A connection changed or reconnected. Close this task and preview again.
strings.transfer.page_backup: Full SQLite backups copy pages; row batch size does not apply.
strings.dbwork.draft.close_body: Confirm discards this editor draft and closes the tab. Saved connections will not be deleted. Cancel keeps editing.
strings.dbwork.draft.switch_title: Discard draft and edit the selected connection?

strings.output.operation.disk_failed: Disk logging failed; recent events remain in memory.

strings.notes.open_limit: Up to 16 notes can be open at once.
strings.notes.sql_driver: SQL regions currently support MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite.
strings.notes.command_done: Command completed; returned rows are not replayed by pagination.
strings.notes.stopped: Stopped; verify the outcome of any writes.
strings.notes.preview_changed: SQL or region changed. Close the preview and prepare again.
strings.notes.results_stale: SQL or connection changed. Run again before paging.
strings.notes.close_dirty: There are unsaved note changes. Save to disk before closing, or keep editing.
strings.notes.close_running: SQL is running or result edits are uncommitted. Stop queries, discard uncommitted result edits and save the note before closing?
strings.notes.settings.title: Note storage
strings.notes.settings.directory_hint: New unnamed notes use this directory. Existing notes stay in their original location and remain accessible; use Save as to move a draft.
strings.notes.settings.autosave_hint: Save after 600 ms without editing. When disabled, save manually; closing unsaved notes prompts before proceeding.
strings.notes.sql_scope: SQL notes execute one statement at a time. Writes always require a preview and confirmation.
strings.notes.empty_cell: Double-click or press F2 to edit
strings.notes.result_editable: Single-table result · edits are staged until confirmed
strings.notes.result_readonly: Read-only result · connection permissions or query mapping
strings.notes.result_no_table: This result has no unique destination table. Copy as CSV or JSON instead.
strings.notes.default_hint: Cells without a connection inherit this scope; explicit cell scopes stay independent.
strings.notes.run_all: Run all SQL cells in order
strings.notes.stop_all: Stop all · already committed changes are not undone
strings.notes.invalid_name: Enter a valid name without path separators or reserved filename characters.
strings.notes.rename_partial: The new file was saved, but the old file could not be removed. Check both files in their folder.
strings.notes.batch_empty: There are no non-empty SQL cells to execute.
strings.notes.batch_changed: Execution stopped because a cell or connection changed. Review before running again.
strings.notes.batch_stopped: Run all stopped; subsequent cells were not executed.
strings.notes.request_changed: SQL or connection changed during the request. The old result was not applied; verify any writes that may have completed.
strings.notes.recent_empty: No recent notes. Create a note or open a .note file.
